title: Wellness Guide
description: A self-care platform to track physical health, mental wellness, and daily routines like hydration, exercise, sleep, mood, and hobbies with reminders.

title: Finance Tracker
description: A personal finance tracker built as part of Ojasa. Helps users track income, expenses, budgets, and visualize spending patterns to manage money better.

title: Rock Paper Scissor Game
description: An interactive Rock Paper Scissor game with score tracking and responsive UI. Built to practice JavaScript logic and DOM manipulation.

title: Weather App
description: A simple weather app that shows current weather conditions using OpenWeather API. Displays temperature, humidity, and weather status based on city search.

title: AI Study Buddy
description: AI-powered study companion that helps students with doubts, summarizes notes, and creates study plans. Built with React frontend and Python FastAPI backend.
